description: Land Title Settlement Department - Tholabugolla, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310085 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and ownership details) by the Commissioner of Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership determinations, property registrations, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
